title: 第23章 阶段性战令开启第24章 护法套餐
slug: 氪金仙尊首先6元即赠绝色剑仙
content_zh:
宋皎皎死了，李清然没死。
搞清楚这个因果关系后，陆长天更是难以置信。
李清然什么实力？靠着常年灵气温养的身体也就只是个厉害点的武者。
宋皎皎呢？没记错是炼气期九层吧。
这个实力杀李清然不就跟碾死一只蚂蚁一样简单。
结果结局却是，宋皎皎死了？！
“宋皎皎是被李清然杀死的？”陆长天瞪着杨博涛。
“我不知道。”杨博涛被吓得不轻，支支吾吾地说：“我只是让她去杀了李清然，她一开始还不愿意，我就说给她搞枚筑基丹，她就去了，后来我不是去取灵石买筑基丹么？回洞府就看到宋皎皎的魂灯碎了。”
人死灯灭。
至少对元婴以下的修士，这四个字就是铁律。
魂灯中寄宿着修士的一丝分魂和一滴精血。
主魂死，生魂如无根浮萍，自然脱离那滴精血消散于世间。
“长天哥哥，这件事蹊跷的紧，我听说最近魔门又开始在苍云界活动了，是不是师姐被魔宗之人夺舍了？”沐白霜露出个害怕的神情：“虽然清然师姐已经不是我们青云宗的人了，可是我还是不希望她被魔门中人害死。”
陆长天脸色阴沉，心里一阵寻思。
杨博涛肯定会被惩罚，这件事跑不脱。
李清然这事儿确实古怪，李清然的死活他无所谓，但李清然绝对不能成为青云宗的隐患。为什么李清然能够击杀宋皎皎，是巧合还是另有原因都必须弄清楚。
正巧听到旁边的沐白霜说：“长天哥哥，清然姐姐到底曾经是我们赤霄峰的人，不能就这么放着不管，否则其他峰会怎么看我们？不管是不是清然姐姐做的，我们把清然姐姐接回来，就算只是让她做个杂役，也好过在万青山中等死。”
她装作才知道李清然下落的样子，眼里都是悲天悯人。
“还是小师妹心善，那李清然这么伤你，你还能为她说话。当初张寒啸就应该直接把她结果了！”
陆长天咬牙切齿，却是把沐白霜的话听进去了。

如果宋皎皎死于意外那就把李清然送离万青山，离青云宗越远越好。
如果宋皎皎真是被李清然杀的，不管李清然是获得什么机遇还是被魔门夺舍那都是个定时炸弹，既然是定时炸弹还是放在眼皮子底下比较好，免得哪天炸了都不知道。
不过，他觉得前者的可能性更大。除了被魔门夺舍或者投靠魔门，他想不到还有什么方法能让一个灵根、丹田都没有的废物击杀一名炼气九层的修士。
师父说了，只有混元补天丹才能恢复丹田。
那可是上古神药，李清然总不可能得那一颗神丹吧？
“师妹不用忧心，这件事我会向师父汇报，无论如何一定会给你一个满意的答复。”陆长天摸了摸沐白霜的头，露出个温柔的笑：“宋皎皎不能白死，若那李清然不是杀宋皎皎的凶手，就把她接回赤霄峰又如何？一个凡人赤霄峰还是养得起的。”
“嗯呢，长天哥哥，你最好啦~”
沐白霜眉眼弯弯，眸子深处闪过一抹狡猾。
陆长天把宋皎皎离奇死亡以及对李清然的猜测上报宗门。
宗主吴段天对此事非常重视，先是惩罚杨博涛雷霆崖面壁思过半年，剥了一个月所有资源配额，随后任命陆长天为领队，带领一队执法堂弟子前去万青山中探查情况。
content_en:
Song Jiaojiao is dead, but Li Qingran is not.
After figuring out this causal relationship, Lu Changtian was even more unbelievable.
What is Li Qingran’s strength? With a body nourished by year-round spiritual energy, he is only a powerful warrior.
Where is Song Jiaojiao? I remember correctly it was the ninth level of the Qi refining stage.
With this strength, killing Li Qingran is not as easy as crushing an ant.
But the ending was that Song Jiaojiao died? !
"Song Jiaojiao was killed by Li Qingran?" Lu Changtian glared at Yang Botao.
"I don't know." Yang Botao was frightened and hesitantly said: "I just asked her to kill Li Qingran. She was not willing at first, so I said I would get her a Foundation-Building Pill, and she went. Later, didn't I go get the spirit stones to buy a Foundation-Building Pill? When I returned to the cave, I saw that Song Jiaojiao's soul lamp was broken."
When a person dies, the light goes out.
At least for monks below Nascent Soul, these four words are iron rules.
The soul lamp contains a trace of the monk's soul and a drop of blood essence.
When the main soul dies, the living soul is like rootless duckweed, naturally separated from the drop of essence and blood and dissipated in the world.
"Brother Changtian, this matter is very strange. I heard that the Demon Sect has started to operate in the Cangyun Realm recently. Has Senior Sister been taken away by someone from the Demon Sect?" Mu Baishuang showed a scared look: "Although Senior Sister Qingran is no longer a member of our Qingyun Sect, I still don't want her to be killed by someone from the Demon Sect."
Lu Changtian's face was gloomy, and he was thinking for a while.
Yang Botao will definitely be punished, and this matter cannot be escaped.
Li Qingran's matter is indeed weird. He doesn't care whether Li Qingran lives or lives, but Li Qingran must not become a hidden danger to the Qingyun Sect. Why Li Qingran was able to kill Song Jiaojiao? Whether it was a coincidence or another reason must be clarified.
I happened to hear Mu Baishuang say next to me: "Brother Changtian, after all, Sister Qingran was once a member of our Chixiao Peak. We can't just leave it alone, otherwise what will other summits think of us? Regardless of whether Sister Qingran did it or not, it is better for us to bring Sister Qingran back, even if she is just a handyman, than waiting to die in Wanqing Mountain."
She pretended to just know Li Qingran's whereabouts, with compassion in her eyes.
"Young junior sister is still kind-hearted, so why can you still speak for Li Qingran when she hurts you so much? Zhang Hanxiao should have killed her directly in the first place!"
Lu Changtian gritted his teeth, but he listened to Mu Baishuang's words.
If Song Jiaojiao dies in an accident, then send Li Qingran away from Wanqing Mountain and as far away from Qingyun Sect as possible.
If Song Jiaojiao was really killed by Li Qingran, no matter whether Li Qingran got some opportunities or was taken away by the Demon Sect, it would be a time bomb. Since it was a time bomb, it was better to keep it under the nose, so as not to know when it exploded.
However, he thinks the former is more likely. Apart from being taken away by the Demon Sect or taking refuge in the Demon Sect, he could not think of any other way for a waste with no spiritual roots or Dantian to kill a monk at the ninth level of Qi Refining.
Master said that only the Hunyuan Tianbu Dan can restore the Dantian.
That was an ancient magic pill. It was impossible for Li Qingran to get that magic pill, right?
"Junior sister, don't worry. I will report this matter to Master and I will definitely give you a satisfactory answer no matter what." Lu Changtian touched Mu Baishuang's head and showed a gentle smile: "Song Jiaojiao cannot die in vain. If Li Qingran is not the murderer of Song Jiaojiao, what if he takes her back to Chixiao Peak? A mortal can still afford it in Chixiao Peak."
"Well, brother Changtian, you are the best~"
Mu Baishuang's eyebrows were curved, and a hint of cunning flashed deep in her eyes.
Lu Changtian reported Song Jiaojiao's mysterious death and his speculation about Li Qingran to the sect.
The leader of the clan, Wu Duantian, took this matter very seriously. He first punished Yang Botao by facing the Thunder Cliff for half a year and deprived him of all resource quotas for a month. Then he appointed Lu Changtian as the team leader and led a group of Law Enforcement Hall disciples to investigate the situation in Wanqing Mountain.
